shells.title: macOS zsh
shells.note: This page covers doctor, project facts and host skill files; it does not promise local model execution on macOS.

shells.title: Linux bash
shells.note: This page covers doctor, project facts and host skill files; Linux GPU/runtime verification is separate.

steps.title: Check Node
steps.why: Confirm that Node meets the package runtime requirement.
steps.expect: Node >=22; install a supported Node release before continuing if needed

steps.title: Install the exact CLI release
steps.why: Install the versioned GitHub release tarball through npm.
steps.expect: opencode-unity 0.1.0-preview.6; npm owns this bootstrap installation, not the product install manifest

onFail.all: Confirm the release asset exists and review the npm error; do not silently substitute another version.

steps.title: Check the installed CLI
steps.why: Confirm the executable matches this documented release.

steps.title: Run static diagnostics
steps.why: Inspect prerequisites and platform support before configuring the runtime.
steps.expect: Review every finding; a missing prerequisite is a diagnostic result, not a successful runtime test

steps.title: Preview Windows setup
steps.why: Review setup operations before approving persistent changes.
steps.expect: A dry-run plan with no files, environment changes, package installs or model pulls applied

zsh.notApplicable: Full setup is documented here only for the Windows reference preset; use doctor and init on this platform.

steps.title: Configure Windows runtime
steps.why: Configure the reference preset after reviewing each setup consent.
steps.expect: Review the 19 GiB base-model download and each requested change before accepting

zsh.notApplicable: Full setup is documented here only for the Windows reference preset; use doctor and init on this platform.

steps.title: Install Claude and Codex skills
steps.why: Install the managed delegation instructions into the selected hosts.
steps.expect: Host skill files match this CLI version; open a new host session after installation

steps.title: Verify host skills
steps.why: Check host file ownership and content without replacing user edits.
steps.expect: Both selected host files are current; inspect missing or modified files before using them

steps.title: Preview project facts
steps.why: Inspect the generated brief without changing the project or product home.
steps.expect: Facts are printed and no files are written; replace the example project path first

steps.title: Save project facts
steps.why: Save the scanned project facts in the product home.
steps.expect: Facts and machine-local state exist under the product home; the repository is unchanged

steps.title: Update managed host skills
steps.why: Refresh host templates while keeping modified files for review.
steps.expect: Current files verify; any preserved edit has a separate candidate to review

steps.title: Preview managed removal
steps.why: Review which recorded changes uninstall can safely remove.
steps.expect: A removal plan with no persistent changes

steps.title: Remove managed host skills
steps.why: Remove only unchanged recorded host skills after confirming the scoped plan.
steps.expect: Modified or unmanaged files are retained and reported
